Axiom:
Deterministic mechanical checks are NOT hand-coded in this directive — they live in one tool, `sdd-check`, which the whole-tree reporter and this directive both consume. Single source of mechanical truth → no drift between the SDD reviewers. Take its findings as given; do NOT hand-redo them.
- `sdd-check --task ` → one ticket: section-anchor balance · Meta + Execution Log present · Task-ID / Status parseable · fabricated DONE · DONE-with-active-blocker · DONE-with-placeholders · phase graph (deps resolve + acyclic) · phase ↔ `PHASE_Pn` section coverage · DONE ⇒ every phase checked. - `sdd-check --all [root]` → the whole tree, additionally: the task DAG (Task-ID collisions · unresolved dependencies · cycles) · tracker ↔ ticket coherence (status drift · missing rows · orphan rows) · spec-link resolution + spec-anchor balance · portal integrity (scope-graph acyclicity · graph↔table↔spec · orphan specs · dangling deps).
Audit owns only what the tool cannot decide mechanically: closed-world symbol diff (code↔inventory), BDD↔test substance, rules-cascade resolution, stale-after-pivot, runtime-backing real-vs-stub, `@consumers` resolvability, append-only `@tasks` vs git. File-header presence (`@file`/`@consumers`/`@tasks`) is checked by `sdd-verify`, not here.
